config.name: Humber Estuary

calibration.method: coordinate search on the main-channel bed profile and Manning n; high/low water and timing
calibration.excluded: New Holland (flat readings, gauge fault); Brough used for high water only (dries at low tide)

config._note: Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD) until calibrated against the Humber gauges. Main channel: tidal Ouse from Naburn Lock and the Humber to Immingham; branch: tidal Trent from Cromwell Lock. Gauge-to-tidal-limit lags are assumed. Hull and other tidal barriers are not modelled.
